messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sun, Aug 30, 2020, aishen wrote:
>
>> xleap has a very bad font ? I tried to change it but I don't know
>> where the right config file� to do it ?
Please visit
http://archive.ambermd.org/201707/0353.html
.  (You can find
this by a Google search on "amber xleap font").
>And when I do� nab nuc.nab, I don't get any pdb file but an executable,
This is expected: "nab" is a compiler that does exactly that: create
executable files.  I'm not sure what is in your nuc.nab file (.nab files
are programs that carry out certain tasks.)  But you should get a
"a.out" file that you then run by typing "./a.out" in a terminal.
...hope this helps...dac
